reviews.title: Exquisite Pollachi craft and genuine NFC verification!
reviews.comment: The split-bamboo finish is so fine and aromatic. Tapped my phone against the rim and immediately saw Meena’s master craft certificate and village geotag. True Indian heritage!

reviews.title: Panchaloha masterpiece — museum grade
reviews.comment: The lost-wax casting details on Nataraja’s flying jata and the ring of fire (prabhavali) are spellbinding. You can feel the weight and spiritual resonance.

reviews.title: Authentic 22K Gold Foil Thanjavur art
reviews.comment: Verified the seal at the back. The Burma teak frame and relief gesso work are immaculate. Shipped with tamper-proof seal.
